subject: Budget range validation - Acme Payments
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sarah Li <sarah.li@acmepay.com>, Carlos Mendes <c.mendes@acmepay.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-06-22T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Budget range validation - Acme Payments

Hi Sarah / Carlos —

Thanks again for taking the time earlier today. Quick recap and a couple of asks so we can size a pilot and the commercial options: 

Call recap (high level):
- Primary use: fraud-detection assistant and dispute-response drafting for customer support.
- Expected initial traffic: ~8k – 15k API calls/day (spikey, peak in US business hours).
- Average tokens per call (roundtrip): ~650 tokens (prompt + completion), conservatively 700 for safety.
- Current ballpark monthly tokens (we estimate): ~12M – 33M tokens/month depending on ramp.

Commercial questions:
1) Can you confirm the procurement threshold / approval bands on your side (i.e., what monthly spend requires PO, what requires legal review)?
2) For budgeting purposes, is a target range helpful (e.g., $5k–$25k / month versus $25k–$100k)?
3) Any constraints on billing cadence (monthly vs. quarterly) or required invoice details?

Attached is a preliminary pricing estimate and a mutual action plan that outlines a simple 3-month pilot + ramp path. High-level pricing reference we discussed: list-price demo for hosted tokens is shown in the attachment — we can provide committed discounts for monthly commitments. Typical unit economics we use to model: target $/1M tokens in the $15–$30 range depending on commitment and latency/availability requirements.

Next steps: if you can share procurement thresholds and a procurement contact, we’ll draft a pilot SOW and a pricing tier that maps to your projected monthly band.

Thanks — I’ll follow up with a revised estimate once I have your thresholds.

Best,
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
D: 415-555-0192 | dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com

Attachment: redwood_pricing_estimate_v1.xlsx
Attachment: mutual_action_plan.docx
From: Sarah Li <sarah.li@acmepay.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Carlos Mendes <c.mendes@acmepay.com>, Acme Payments Procurement <procurement@acmepay.com>
Date: 2026-06-23T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Budget range validation - Acme Payments

Hi Dylan —

Thanks for the clear recap and the attachments — helpful. A few data points from our finance/procurement side: 

- Budget bands: initial pilot budget we can approve without PO up to ~$10k (we can do credit card or P-card).
- PO requirement: anything >$10k/month requires a PO and finance approval.
- Legal review: spend >$50k total or contracts with data residency clauses kick it to Legal (should be a multi-week process).

On usage: Carlos and I did a quick sanity check with the product team — your token estimate looks right. We expect maybe 10M tokens/month in month 1 if adoption is modest, ramping to ~25–30M/month by month 3 if the pilot goes well.

Target unit economics: our head of platform asked us to aim for ~ $18–$22 per 1M tokens for the pilot. If we can get a committed monthly spend (PO-level) we could consider a lower $/1M starting in month 2.

Procurement contact: procurement@acmepay.com (cc'd). They will route any PO requests and provide our standard vendor form. Also we will need SOC 2 Type II evidence and data processing addendum before signing.

Can you produce a short (1-page) pilot SOW + pricing table at the $/1M bands (list, pilot discount, committed discount) and indicate invoice terms (Net 30 / monthly)? That will help us fast-track the pilot.

Thanks,
Sarah Li
Head of Product Operations | Acme Payments

[Procurement contact included on cc]
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-06-23T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Budget range validation - Acme Payments

Dylan —

Based on Sarah's note, here's a quick pricing playbook you can offer that maps to their expected bands and procurement constraints: 

Tiered approach (recommended):
- Pilot (0–10M tokens/month): $24 per 1M tokens (no-commit, month-to-month) — allows them to run without PO.
- Growth (10–50M tokens/month): $18–$20 per 1M tokens with a 3-month committed monthly spend (PO) — reduces unit cost once they commit.
- Enterprise (50M+ tokens/month): $12–$15 per 1M tokens with annual commitment and SLA terms.

Notes:
- If procurement requires a PO >$10k/month, we should present the Growth tier with a simple SOW and a monthly PO.
- Offer an introductory pilot discount: first month 15% off list for the Pilot tier if they sign before the end of the quarter.
- Highlight that committed monthly spend can be invoiced monthly (Net 30) but locked-in rates for the commitment term.

I attached a revised pricing tiers spreadsheet that maps example monthly spend bands to estimated $/month and $/1M tokens for their averages. Use this to show the math to procurement.

Happy to hop on a quick sync if you want to run through the numbers with finance.

—Marissa
Sr. Sales Operations | Redwood Inference

Attachment: revised_pricing_tiers.xlsx
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sarah Li <sarah.li@acmepay.com>, Carlos Mendes <c.mendes@acmepay.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Acme Payments Procurement <procurement@acmepay.com>
Date: 2026-06-24T08:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Budget range validation - Acme Payments

Sarah / Carlos —

Great, thanks for the clarity. Action items / proposal: 

1) Pilot SOW + pricing table: I will send a 1-page pilot SOW with three pricing rows: Pilot (no PO, month-to-month), Growth (PO + 3-month commitment), and Enterprise (annual commit).

2) Recommended pricing to match your ask: propose Growth tier at $18/1M tokens for 10–50M tokens/month if you put a PO for a 3-month commitment. Pilot month we can start at $20/1M tokens on a card up to $10k to avoid PO friction. 

3) Billing / procurement: we support monthly invoices (Net 30). Procurement, can you confirm if Acme requires vendor onboarding forms before issuing a PO and who is our procurement contact for the vendor questionnaire?

4) Security: Marissa / Neha will coordinate SOC 2 evidence; I'll include the links in the SOW.

Next step: I’ll circulate the one-page SOW and pricing table by EOD tomorrow. If you’re comfortable with the proposed Growth $18/1M for committed PO, we’ll prepare the document for procurement to intake the PO.

Thanks —
Dylan
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

On Thu, Jun 23, 2026 at 09:18 AM Sarah Li <sarah.li@acmepay.com> wrote:
> Thanks again — we should be able to move quickly on the pilot once we have the SOW.
From: Sarah Li <sarah.li@acmepay.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Carlos Mendes <c.mendes@acmepay.com>, Acme Payments Procurement <procurement@acmepay.com>
Date: 2026-06-26T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Budget range validation - Acme Payments

Dylan —

Appreciate the proposal. Procurement confirms: vendor onboarding form is required for PO issuance; procurement@acmepay.com will send the vendor packet. Our procurement lead is Priya Natarajan (I copied procurement alias but will route Priya's contact once the packet is ready).

We are comfortable to run a pilot under these terms: 
- Pilot month on card or internal budget up to $10k (no PO).
- If pilot reaches expected usage, we will issue a PO for a 3-month committed period targeting ~12–20M tokens/month at $18/1M tokens (monthly invoicing, Net 30).
- Please include SOC 2 Type II evidence and a DPA in the SOW; legal will review only if total spend >$50k or if there are non-standard data-residency clauses.

Procurement link (portal): https://acmeprocurement.example.com/vendor-onboard?id=PR-9812

If you can send the 1-page SOW + pricing table and a draft invoice template, I’ll push this to procurement and finance. Looking forward to running the pilot.

Thanks,
Sarah Li
Head of Product Operations | Acme Payments
thread_summary: Post-call follow-up to validate token volumes and procurement thresholds for a pilot with Acme Payments. Discussed expected monthly tokens (10–30M), procurement PO thresholds (> $10k/month), and target unit economics (~$18/1M tokens for a committed 3-month PO). Next steps: send 1-page SOW, SOC 2 evidence, vendor onboarding packet link; procurement will issue PO if pilot validates usage.
